note: Synthetic expected-contract cases only; not empirical model fits, biological truth, or current Symtropy performance.

cases.setup: Two mechanisms fit calibration history but diverge under a frozen intervention.

required_properties: fit and intervention qualification remain separate
both model forecasts remain available

fail_if: best historical fit automatically qualifies the model

cases.setup: Two registered models match history but predict different futures.

required_properties: per-model forecasts and between-model disagreement are preserved

cases.setup: One ensemble varies coefficients while another changes a causal/process edge.

required_properties: parameter and structural uncertainty have distinct fields

fail_if: seed/parameter spread stands in for missing mechanism

cases.setup: Ten executions share identical rules and differ only by random seed.

required_properties: replicas share structure ID

cases.setup: Candidates differ by trophic edge, process lag or update rule.

required_properties: structure digest changes

cases.setup: Ensemble weights were chosen after inspecting frozen test results.

required_properties: run marked invalid or exploratory

cases.setup: Dependent frames/time blocks from one episode overlap calibration and test.

required_properties: auditor detects group overlap

cases.setup: Models yield distinct forecasts for one unit and horizon.

required_properties: individual forecasts remain available beside summaries

cases.setup: Mixture forecasts have separated modes with little mass around the mean.

required_properties: modes or model-conditioned distributions are shown

fail_if: mean presented as representative without spread

cases.setup: Plausible models predict opposite intervention-effect directions.

required_properties: direction disagreement reaches decision layer

cases.setup: All candidates share an omitted-process limitation.

cases.setup: Immediate and delayed models share endpoint but differ in transient outcome.
